prompt: CSS grid find fr size flex factor sum less than threshold
answer:
In CSS Grid, if the sum of the flexible (`fr`) track factors is less than **1**, the algorithm sets the sum to **1**. Consequently, the tracks occupy only their corresponding fraction of the leftover space rather than expanding to fill it.

Source: [W3C CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-grid-1/); [CSS { In Real Life }](https://css-irl.info/debugging-css-grid-part-2-what-the-fraction/)
